required_followup: Lane source-based adjudication, independent exact-version check, and a versioned enum-definition proposal if ambiguity persists.
risk_screen: Reported RISK_SCREEN_006 238 candidates in L04; count not independently reverified by this policy note and not an omission/error estimate.
rules: answer_set_status describes represented answer-set inventory; it is not evidence that the original source has no answer. Existing none values have ambiguous historical producer intent and must not support a negative source assertion.

An active answer edge targeting a question with none is a consistency-risk candidate, not automatically a confirmed source error. Read the question, answer, conditions and relevant continuation; verify the edge target and represented inventory.

For new records, use partial only when source-supported alternatives or an answer inventory are actually represented for that exact question; scope and continuation limits must remain explicit. Do not manufacture alternatives to satisfy an enum.
Do not infer complete or mutually comparable alternatives from partial, topic_inventory or unreviewed_alternatives. None of the enum values alone grants choice-QA eligibility.
Preserve source-present answers and their relations even if inventory eligibility is restricted. Distinguish a reason-question, count-question, rejected proposal and final local position.
Corrections use immutable superseding records with exact evidence and dependent coverage updates. No automatic bulk relabeling, deletion or blanket quarantine.
Existing source-based correction findings and exact-role quarantines remain in force; this note grants no clearance.
versioning_boundary: Does not alter frozen schema/protocol or reinterpret old producer intent. A normative enum migration requires a new versioned contract and impact assessment.
